stylists.title: Dominican Hairdresser
stylists.bio: Johanny is a Dominican hairdresser who specialises in Dominican hair care — silky blowouts, silk presses, keratin smoothing, and rich color. Her focus is healthy hair that's smooth and full of life. Call 954-649-5573 or 954-977-8533 to book, and follow Johanny Dominican Hairdresser on Instagram and Facebook.

reviews.name: Yesenia R.
reviews.text: Johanny's Dominican blowout is the best! My hair was so silky, straight, and full of movement.

reviews.name: Carolina M.
reviews.text: The keratin treatment made my hair so smooth and easy to manage. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Tanya B.
reviews.text: She gave me a gorgeous red color and a sleek bob. I've never gotten so many compliments.

reviews.name: Maria L.
reviews.text: Healthy hair every time. Johanny really cares about her clients. ¡Excelente!
